description: This file contains a comprehensive set of Bash shell functions and test cases for managing and verifying Git submodule operations within a larger git project. It includes functions to create submodule repositories, manipulate submodule states, test various transition scenarios (adding, removing, replacing submodules, nested submodules, etc.), and ensure correct behavior of Git commands with submodules, including recursive updates and forced switches.

methods.name: create_lib_submodule_repo
methods.description: Initializes a set of Git repositories to simulate submodule scenarios, including adding, removing, modifying submodules, nesting, and replacing submodules with files or directories.

methods.name: replace_gitfile_with_git_dir
methods.description: Replaces a submodule's .git file with a full .git directory to simulate embedded git directories.

methods.name: test_git_directory_is_unchanged
methods.description: Checks that a submodule's .git directory remains unchanged after certain operations.

methods.name: test_git_directory_exists
methods.description: Verifies the existence of a submodule's .git directory.

methods.name: test_superproject_content
methods.description: Ensures that the superproject's working tree and index match a specific commit.

methods.name: test_submodule_content
methods.description: Checks that a submodule's directory content matches the recorded commit within the superproject.

methods.name: test_submodule_switch_func
methods.description: Runs a suite of tests to verify submodule switch operations, both normal and forced, including adding, removing, replacing, and updating submodules.

methods.name: test_submodule_switch
methods.description: Wrapper for testing submodule switch operations using 'git' commands.

methods.name: test_submodule_forced_switch
methods.description: Wrapper for testing forced submodule switch operations ignoring local changes.

methods.name: test_submodule_recursing_with_args_common
methods.description: Underlying function to test recursive submodule operations with various transition scenarios.

methods.name: test_submodule_switch_recursing_with_args
methods.description: Tests recursive submodule switch operations with specific git commands.

methods.name: test_submodule_forced_switch_recursing_with_args
methods.description: Tests forced recursive submodule switch operations, ignoring local changes and conflicts.
